name: Psi-DOM
summary: ψ-DOM, or psi-DOM, also known as 2,6-dimethoxy-4-methylamphetamine or as Z-7, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and Ψ-PEA families related to DOM. It is a positional isomer of DOM in which the methoxy group at the 5 position has been relocated to the 6 position. The drug is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: ψ-DOM shows affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 49–351 nM and 50 nM, respectively). Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was about 2.6- to 3.5-fold lower than that of DOM. The drug acts as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor similarly to DOM.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist
